settings.browser.nextStart: What is set here applies the next time Daoris's browser starts. Close its windows and open it again to see it now.
settings.browser.which.title: Which browser
settings.browser.which.label: Sessions and you use
settings.browser.which.hintDaoris: Daoris's own browser runs on the engine Daoris ships, on a profile of its own, signed in to no account until you sign in to a site.
settings.browser.which.hintEdge: Edge runs on a profile of Daoris's at {{profile}}. Edge signs that profile in to your Windows account's Microsoft account on its own, and its sync and extensions are yours to turn on there. Your default Edge profile cannot be driven: Chromium refuses a debug port on it.
settings.browser.which.noEdge: No Edge is installed on this machine, so choosing it would open nothing.
settings.browser.which.set: {{choice}}, from the next time the browser is opened.
settings.browser.ownOnly: Favorites and the extensions setting below are Daoris's own browser's. Edge keeps its own.
settings.browser.driving.label: Driving it now
settings.browser.driving.hint: The running sessions handed a server that drives it, each until it ends.
settings.browser.links.label: Links on the page open in
settings.browser.links.hint: Also `daoris browser links system|daoris`. No restart: it holds from the next click. A sign-in link always opens in the system's browser.
settings.browser.links.why: A ticket in a quest or an ask, a URL in a conversation, a link in what an agent wrote: opened in Daoris's browser, it is where your sessions' sign-ins are and where an agent's hands can reach it. Daoris's browser is the one chosen above, its own or your Edge.
settings.browser.links.setDaoris: Links on the page open in Daoris's browser, from the next click.
settings.browser.links.setSystem: Links on the page open in the system's browser, from the next click.
settings.browser.favorites.title: Favorites
settings.browser.favorites.label: Favorites file
settings.browser.favorites.hint: Pages Daoris keeps for you, shown in a Daoris folder on the browser's bookmarks bar. The browser's own bookmarks stay its own.
settings.browser.extensions.title: Other software's extensions
settings.browser.extensions.label: Registered for Chrome
settings.browser.extensions.hint: Some programs register an extension for every Chrome-based browser on the machine. Offered, the browser asks you to approve each one; refused, it never offers them.
settings.browser.extensions.set: Other software's extensions will be {{choice}} from the browser's next start.
